snippet.title: A Game About Opening A Chest - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4088850/A_Game_About_Opening_A_Chest/

Open a Chest of infinite loot, collect legendary items, and create game-breaking synergies in this unique incremental roguelike. Grow your fortune, use NPCs to your advantage, and survive the perils of the dungeon in this addictive game of luck, risk, and rewards. When in doubt, open more Chests!
